args.subject: Laksa Lab x @mayacooks.sg - a 3-post bundle for Tiong Bahru
args.body:
Hi Wei Sheng,

I'm Maya, I cook hawker-style food in my HDB kitchen for about 8,000 people on TikTok. My laksa video did 18,400 views and the top comment was people asking where to buy a proper bowl nearby.

I noticed Laksa Lab has no reels yet. I'd like to fix that.

Proposal: 3 posts over 2 weeks - one stall visit, one at-home comparison, one Reel cut for Instagram. You get full usage rights for 6 months.

Bundle: SGD 650. Local micro-creator rates run SGD 600-900 for the same package, so this sits at the low end while I'm building my brand roster.

I'm filming Tuesday and Thursday this week if you'd like the first one out fast.

Maya
@mayacooks.sg

value.summary: Short IG DM as the Wednesday nudge.

args.message: Hi! Maya here (@mayacooks.sg) - I sent an email about a 3-post bundle for Laksa Lab. My laksa video did 18k views and people kept asking where to buy a real bowl. Happy to send the first cut before you commit to anything. Filming Tuesday if you're keen.

value.summary: Walk-in call script with 3 objection handles.

args.context: Walk-in or phone call to Laksa Lab, Tiong Bahru
args.opening: Hi Wei Sheng, I'm Maya - I cook hawker food at home for about 8,000 people online. I sent you an email about filming here. Do you have two minutes?
key_points: My laksa video did 18,400 views and the comments were people asking where to buy a real bowl nearby
You have 340 followers and no reels - that is the whole gap
I film Tuesday and Thursday, so the first video can be live this week

objections.objection: We don't have budget for marketing.
objections.response: Then let's start with one post at SGD 250 and you only book the bundle if it moves queue numbers.

objections.objection: How do I know it will work?
objections.response: You don't yet. That's why I'll send you the first cut before it goes live, and you can kill it.

objections.objection: Can you just do it for free food?
objections.response: I can't do the bundle for trade, but I'll do one post for a meal plus usage rights if we agree the bundle rate for anything after that.

args.close: Can I come film Tuesday around 3pm, before your dinner rush?
